clockMeaning: Fixed business-time fixture, not the experiment's actual execution timestamp
generation: 3 rows of 8 enabled seats, one shared area/tier, one aisle segment in each row; 100.00 per seat; forbidNewOrphan=true; new session each round; no randomness
concurrency: 12 ready-latch workers released together, 8 distinct consumers, unique keys; the Hikari pool may limit active DB connections; same-session writers serialize at the session row lock
orderWriteIsolation: READ_COMMITTED declared by the existing OrderTransactionService
submissionOrder: Rotate by round modulo 12, reverse odd rounds; reverse seat IDs on alternating requests; no assertion about which user wins
limits: Finite in-process service calls only, no HTTP or multi-JVM test; no latency/throughput claim; checks inventory allocation before payment, not later payment/check-in races; test profile disables background scanners
